COURT TRIAL ON APR-14-2009 IN DEPT. 318. WITNESSES SWORN AND EXAMINED, DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE INTRODUCED/ADMITTED. PARTIES REST. THE COURT RULES THAT PLAINTIFF SHALL HAVE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PROPERTY LOCATED AT 38 WILDER STREET, SAN FRANCISCO, CA 94131. DEFENDANT SHALL PAY THE FAIR MARKET VALUE OF $50.00 PER DAY FROM JANUARY 26, 2009 THROUGH THE DATE OF JUDGMENT. THE COURT GRANTS A 10-DAY STAY OF EXECUTION OF POSSESSION OF THE PROPERTY THROUGH APRIL 24, 2009. THE COURT SETS A HEARING DATE OF APR-23-2009 AT 9:00AM IN DEPT 318 FOR DEFENDANT'S APPLICATION FOR FURTHER STAY. PLAINTIFF SHALL PREPARE AND SUBMIT A PROPOSED JUDGMENT, APPROVED AS TO FORM. JUDGE DONALD J. SULLIVAN, CLERK: V. MACK, REPORTER: DIANA PADILLA CSR 9975
